extracted.description: Extract the archive at path into the dest directory (tar/tar.gz/tar.bz2/zip); ADR-015.

max_entries.description: Limit on the number of entries in the archive; default 100000. Zip-bomb protection.

max_ratio.description: Limit on the ratio of extracted to compressed bytes (compression ratio); default 100, 0 — disabled. Zip-bomb protection for a small compressed size.

max_size.description: Limit on total extracted size (number of bytes or N[KiB|MiB|GiB]); default 1GiB. Zip-bomb protection.

delivered.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). Install/deliver and redeem per-host bootstrap tokens over direct SSH or Teleport (ADR-063).

hosts.description: Per-host issued-token objects. primary_ip is required only for direct transport; Teleport addresses hosts by sid.

install.description: Install the full Soul setup before token delivery (Teleport only).

join_wait_timeout.description: Teleport join wait as a duration string (integer seconds is also accepted at runtime).

ssh_provider.description: SshProvider name; retained as audit metadata in Teleport mode.

issued.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). Atomically issue per-host bootstrap tokens for ready-made VM SIDs, independent of core.cloud.created.

sids.description: Non-empty unique list of ready-made VM FQDN/SIDs.

absent.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). The Voice with sid is absent from the run's Choir (ADR-044).

choir.description: Name of the Choir part within the incarnation.

incarnation.description: Name of the incarnation whose Choir is managed.

sid.description: SID (FQDN) of the Soul whose Voice is removed from the Choir.

present.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). The Voice with sid is present in the run's Choir (ADR-044).

choir.description: Name of the Choir part within the incarnation.

incarnation.description: Name of the incarnation whose Choir is managed.

position.description: Position of the Voice within the part (>= 0).

role.description: Free-form role label of the voice in the choir.

sid.description: SID (FQDN) of the Soul whose Voice is added to the Choir.

created.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). Cloud VMs created through a CloudDriver plugin (ADR-017).

name.description: Base name for the VM batch (self-onboard Variant T): keeper predicts FQDN=<name>-<index>.<suffix>. Required with self_onboard.

provider.description: Name of the cloud Provider in the registry (driver + credentials + region).

self_onboard.description: The VM onboards itself from cloud-init (Variant T, ADR-017(h)): keeper predicts the FQDN and bakes per-VM tokens into userdata. Requires name + providers.fqdn_suffix.

userdata.description: Cloud-init userdata (mutually exclusive with generate_userdata and self_onboard).

destroyed.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). Cloud VMs destroyed, registries cascade-updated (ADR-017).

provider.description: Name of the cloud Provider in the registry.

resized.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). Cloud VM resources changed to an absolute target size via CloudDriver.Resize (capability Resizable).

allow_downtime.description: Allow downtime (stop/start) for cpu/ram resize. Required when changing cpu/ram; disk-only is online (default false).

desired.description: Target resources in our units: cpu_cores (cores) / ram_mb (MB) / disk_gb (GB). At least one > 0; fields with 0 are unchanged.

provider.description: Name of the cloud Provider in the registry.

vm_ids.description: provider-vm-ids to resize (one target for the whole batch).

shell.description: Run a shell string via `sh -c` (pipes/redirects/glob). TRUSTED-ONLY (ADR-015).

creates.description: Idempotency: if the file exists — the step is skipped (changed=false).

present.description: Job file /etc/cron.d/<name> with the given schedule and command (ADR-015).

absent.description: Directory is removed. An empty directory is always removed; a non-empty one only with recursive:true, otherwise an error (a deliberate divergence from a silent rm -rf).

path.description: Path of the directory to remove.

recursive.description: Remove a non-empty directory's contents (rm -r semantics). Default false: a non-empty directory errors.

present.description: Directory exists with the given owner/group/mode (replacement for `core.exec.run install -d`, ADR-015).

parents.description: Create intermediate directories (mkdir -p semantics). Default false.

run.description: Run a process with argv without a shell (ADR-015).

creates.description: Idempotency: if the file exists — the step is skipped (changed=false).

path.description: Path of the file to remove.

present.description: File exists with the given content/mode/owner/group (ADR-015).

content.description: File content (inline). Mutually exclusive with src; if neither is given, an empty file.

src.description: Absolute path of a regular file on the host, its content is copied to path (typically the result of core.archive.extracted). Sets only the content, not the source's attributes. Mutually exclusive with content.

rendered.description: File = result of rendering a text/template template (ADR-010).

path.description: Target path of the rendered file.

template.description: Path to the .tmpl template (resolved locally, then service-level).

vars.description: Render variables (visible to the template as .vars.*).

source.description: IPv4 CIDR or a single IPv4.
IPv4 CIDR or a single IPv4 (default any). IPv6 not supported in MVP.

cloned.description: Path contains a git repo (cloned if absent); ADR-015.

pulled.description: Clone-if-missing + git pull --ff-only. Changed only when HEAD changes.

gid.description: Explicit gid (groupadd -g). Only takes effect on creation.

system.description: System group (groupadd -r), gid from the system range. Only on creation.

probe.description: Read-probe of an HTTP endpoint (GET/HEAD); read-only, changed is always false. ADR-015/ADR-016, https-only.

allow_http.description: Allow http:// (lift https-only); file:// remains forbidden. Does not open up SSRF (default false).

allow_private.description: Lift the SSRF-guard for internal health-checks (default false).

headers.description: HTTP headers (values are secret, excluded from output).

insecure_skip_verify.description: Disable TLS verification (self-signed / internal CA); MITM risk (default false).

method.description: HTTP method GET|HEAD (default GET); mutating methods are forbidden.

status_codes.description: Expected response codes (list of int); defaults to 2xx.

url.description: Target URL (https:// only; SSRF-guard on the resolved IP).

request.description: One mutating HTTP API request (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE); success reports changed=true. ADR-015/ADR-016, https-only.

allow_http.description: Allow http:// (lift https-only); file:// remains forbidden. Does not open up SSRF (default false).

allow_private.description: Lift the SSRF-guard for an explicitly trusted internal API (default false).

body.description: Optional request body. The response body, not this request body, is returned in output.body.

content_type.description: Optional Content-Type header; when set, overrides headers[Content-Type].

headers.description: HTTP headers (all values are sensitive-by-construction; output contains keys only).

insecure_skip_verify.description: Disable TLS verification (self-signed / internal CA); MITM risk (default false).

method.description: Explicit mutating HTTP method POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE; GET/HEAD are forbidden.

status_codes.description: Expected response codes (list of int); defaults to [200].

url.description: Target URL (https:// only; SSRF-guard on the resolved IP).

absent.description: Removes matching lines (by regexp — all; otherwise by exact line).

create.description: Create the file if it doesn't exist.

line.description: Exact line to remove (either line or regexp is required).

regexp.description: RE2 pattern: all matching lines are removed.

present.description: The line is present in the file (with regexp — replaces the first matching line); ADR-015.

create.description: Create the file if it doesn't exist.

insertafter.description: Literal anchor or EOF — where to insert (mutually exclusive with insertbefore).

insertbefore.description: Literal anchor or BOF — where to insert (mutually exclusive with insertafter).

line.description: Exact line being managed (required for present).

mode.description: Permissions on create, octal form, e.g. "0644".

regexp.description: RE2 pattern: the first matching line is replaced with line.

installed.description: The SoulModule plugin from the active Sigil grant is pulled from Keeper (FetchModule), verified, and atomically installed into a catalog slot of the module cache. Idempotent by the binary's sha256 (ADR-065).

ref.description: Pin check (NOT a version selector): the active Sigil grant must be on this ref, otherwise module_not_allowed.

mounted.description: Only mounted "as is" (without editing fstab) - runtime-mount.

run.description: No-op. Does nothing, always succeeds with no change (changed=false). barrier anchor / placeholder; ADR-015.

installed.description: Package installed (optionally at an exact version). Idempotent (ADR-015).

latest.description: Package installed and updated to the latest available version.

absent.description: Repository description removed (GPG key is not touched).

dest.description: Absolute path of the repo description file to remove, if it was created with a custom dest (apt/dnf/yum).

present.description: Package repository declared (description file + GPG key); apt/dnf/yum/apk. ADR-015/ADR-016.

arch.description: apt repo architectures (e.g. [amd64]) -> arch= in options; apt only, [a-z0-9].

dest.description: Absolute path of the repo description file, overriding the backend default (apt /etc/apt/sources.list.d/<name>.list; dnf/yum /etc/yum.repos.d/<name>.repo). Not for apk (single repositories file).

gpg_check.description: Verify package signatures (default true; opt-out produces a warning).

gpg_key.description: GPG key (supply-chain): apt - inline keyring, materialized under /etc/apt/keyrings/ as <name>.asc when armored and <name>.gpg otherwise, since apt picks its parser from the extension; dnf/yum - URL or path in gpgkey=. Key-by-URL for apt - via core.url.fetched (ADR-071 option B).

gpg_key_path.description: Path to a GPG key already present on the host: apt -> signed-by=<path>, dnf/yum -> gpgkey=<path>. The module only references it (no copy) and guards its existence on plan/apply. Mutually exclusive with gpg_key; deliver the key first (core.url.fetched/core.file). Not for apk.

uri.description: Repository URL (http/https; http produces a mandatory warning).

disabled.description: Service autostart on system boot is off (orthogonal to the running/stopped runtime state — a disabled unit may still be running).

daemon_reload.description: systemctl daemon-reload before enable (systemd): auto = on NeedDaemonReload, always = unconditionally, never = opt-out. openrc/sysv — no-op (ADR-015).

masked.description: The unit is masked (systemctl mask, symlink → /dev/null) — start is impossible manually or as a dependency. systemd-only; openrc/sysv is a fatal error. Apply disables the unit before masking (ADR-015).

daemon_reload.description: systemctl daemon-reload before restart (systemd): auto = on NeedDaemonReload, always = unconditionally, never = opt-out. openrc/sysv — no-op (ADR-015).

running.description: The service is running. The optional enabled controls autostart in one step (ADR-015).

daemon_reload.description: systemctl daemon-reload before start (systemd): auto = on NeedDaemonReload, always = unconditionally, never = opt-out. openrc/sysv — no-op (ADR-015).

enabled.description: true → additionally enable, false → disable, omitted → leave autostart untouched.

registered.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). The bind act — a Soul with sid becomes a member of the run's incarnation (incarnation_membership) and optionally carries stable Coven tags (ADR-017; ADR-008 amendment NIM-124). Onboarding barrier — ADR-061.

await_min_count.description: Minimum number of online hosts for the barrier to succeed. Default — the number of SIDs being registered (all).

await_online.description: Onboarding barrier (ADR-061): after registration, block waiting until the created Souls become online (Redis SID lease).

await_timeout.description: Upper bound on the barrier wait. REQUIRED when await_online: true. Ceiling — keeper.yml::max_await_timeout.

coven.description: Optional set of stable Coven tags (kebab-case), applied to all SIDs. Membership is implicit (incarnation_membership), NOT a coven value — ADR-008 amendment NIM-124.

refresh_soulprint.description: Mid-run re-resolve of the run's roster (ADR-061; stratification/re-resolve — slices S2/S3, echo refreshed:false).

sid.description: SID (FQDN) of the target Soul: a single string OR a list (via CEL `${ register.<step>.hosts }`) — registering N hosts in one barrier step, ADR-061.

applied.description: Bulk set of kernel parameters as one deterministic drop-in in /etc/sysctl.d (sorted keys) + a targeted sysctl -p <file> on change; ADR-015 amend (the module itself owns drop-in+reload+idempotency).

filename.description: Drop-in file name in /etc/sysctl.d (e.g. 30-redis); the .conf suffix is added automatically.

ignore_failures.description: sysctl -e -p (--ignore): suppresses read-only/nonexistent keys in containers. Explicit opt-in.

reload.description: sysctl -p <file> after writing: auto = only when the file changed, always = unconditionally, never = opt-out. reload itself does not mark changed (reuses the core.service daemon_reload dictionary).

settings.description: Map of kernel parameter→value. Keys are sorted → drop-in content is deterministic.

present.description: Kernel parameter name=value (runtime via sysctl -w + persist in /etc/sysctl.d); ADR-015.

fetched.description: Download a file over https to path with checksum verification (ADR-015/ADR-016, https-only).

allow_http.description: Allow http:// (downgrade risk). Does NOT open up SSRF — the dial-guard is held separately (allow_private).

allow_private.description: Drop the SSRF guard: allow dialing metadata/loopback/RFC1918 (legitimate internal endpoint).

headers.description: HTTP request headers (values are secret, never appear in output). If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since here give conditional-GET (304 → no-op).

insecure_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS chain verification (self-signed / internal CA). MITM risk.

url.description: Source (https:// only; SSRF-guard on the resolved IP).

present.description: User exists (present-or-create, no reconcile of an existing user; ADR-015).

group.description: Primary group (useradd -g); must already exist. Only on creation.

groups.description: Supplementary groups (useradd -G). Applies only on creation.

home.description: Home directory (useradd -d). Applies only on creation.

shell.description: Login shell (useradd -s). Applies only on creation.

system.description: System account (useradd -r) for service accounts. Only on creation.

uid.description: Explicit uid (useradd -u). Applies only on creation.

kv-present.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). Generate-if-absent - guarantees the secret exists (generates the missing crypto/rand per policy; if present - no-op, never returns values).

policy.description: Step-level default policy for all targets: length (8..1024, default 32), charset (alphanumeric|hex|base64url|ascii-printable-safe) OR allowed_chars (mutually exclusive).

targets.description: Non-empty list of targets {path: <Vault KV path without #field>, field?: <field name, default password>, policy?: <per-target override>}.

kv-read.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). Explicit read of Vault KV with an audit-event (ADR-017).

fields.description: Which keys to extract; empty -> the whole secret.

data.description: The extracted keys and their values.

fields.description: Names of the keys in data, sorted.

path.description: Echo of the requested Vault KV path.

add.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). Adds ONE element to the collection field named by field, idempotently: an element with the same identity (key or match) is not added twice (ADR-057).

field.description: Top-level property name of the service state_schema to write. The Vault path of each declared secret is DERIVED from (service, incarnation, this field, the element's key) and is never authored.

key.description: Identity of the element in a MAP field: the key it is stored under, an existing entry under the same key being the conflict. Mutually exclusive with match, which is the LIST-field spelling - which of the two the engine reads is decided by the field's kind, so writing the wrong one is an error, not a fallback.

match.description: Identity of the element in a LIST field: a CEL predicate over `elem` and `value` deciding whether an existing element is the same one, e.g. `elem.name == value.name`. Omitted, identity is deep equality of the whole element. Mutually exclusive with key, which is the MAP-field spelling.

on_conflict.description: What to do when the element already exists: skip (default, no-op), replace (overwrite it), error (fail the run).

value.description: The element to add. A secret property of the element is written as generate_secret({'length': …, 'charset': …}).

append.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). Appends ONE element to the list field named by field, unconditionally — no identity check. For a sequence where the same element may legitimately occur twice; use add for a set.

field.description: Top-level property name of the service state_schema to write. The Vault path of each declared secret is DERIVED from (service, incarnation, this field, the element's key) and is never authored.

value.description: The element to append. A secret property of the element is written as generate_secret({'length': …, 'charset': …}).

modify.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). Patches every element of the collection field named by field that matches match (ADR-057). Writes no value of its own, so it mints no secret.

expect.description: How many elements the match must select: any (default), one, at_most_one. A count outside it fails the run before the commit.

field.description: Top-level property name of the service state_schema to write. The Vault path of each declared secret is DERIVED from (service, incarnation, this field, the element's key) and is never authored.

match.description: CEL predicate over `elem` selecting which elements to patch, e.g. `elem.name == 'alice'`. Omitted, it matches NOTHING and the step is a no-op - write `true` to patch every element.

patch.description: Path-inside-the-element -> new value. A value may be a CEL expression over `elem`, so a patch can be computed from what the element already holds.

present.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). Writes the state field named by field ONLY if it has no value yet; an existing value wins, including one written earlier in the same run. Nothing is minted for a write that is discarded.

field.description: Top-level property name of the service state_schema to write. The Vault path of each declared secret is DERIVED from (service, incarnation, this field, the element's key) and is never authored.

value.description: The value to write if the field is empty. A secret property is written as generate_secret({'length': …, 'charset': …}).

remove.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). Drops every element of the collection field named by field that matches match (ADR-057). Removes elements from inside the field; use unset to drop the field itself.

expect.description: How many elements the match must select: any (default), one, at_most_one. A count outside it fails the run before the commit.

field.description: Top-level property name of the service state_schema to write. The Vault path of each declared secret is DERIVED from (service, incarnation, this field, the element's key) and is never authored.

match.description: CEL predicate over `elem` selecting which elements to drop, e.g. `elem.name == 'alice'`. Omitted, it matches NOTHING and the step is a no-op - a forgotten line drops nothing. Write `true` to drop every element, or use core.state.unset to drop the field itself.

set.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). Writes the state field named by field, replacing whatever it held. Returns the effective state with each declared secret property replaced by its `vault:` reference ([ADR-0084]).

field.description: Top-level property name of the service state_schema to write. The Vault path of each declared secret is DERIVED from (service, incarnation, this field, the element's key) and is never authored.

value.description: The field's whole value. A secret property is written as generate_secret({'length': …, 'charset': …}); omitting it requires the value to already exist.

unset.description: Keeper-side (on:keeper). Drops the state field named by field itself, as opposed to remove, which drops elements from inside a collection.

field.description: Top-level property name of the service state_schema to write. The Vault path of each declared secret is DERIVED from (service, incarnation, this field, the element's key) and is never authored.
